name: Oreo Cream Biscuit
ingredients: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Fat, Palmolein, Cocoa Solids (3%*), Invert Sugar, Leavening Agents [500(ii), 503(ii)], lodised Salt, Emulsifier (322).
